evidence.title: React Hook Form - performant, flexible and extensible form library

name: React Hook Form
summary: React form library with easy validation, tiny size and no dependencies; works with native HTML inputs and UI libraries.
description: Performant, flexible forms for React with easy validation. Rely on native HTML markup and constraint-based validation, and isolate re-renders by subscribing to individual fields. Hooks include useForm, useController, useFormContext, useWatch, useFormState and useFieldArray; components include Form, Controller, FormProvider and ErrorMessage. Works with React Native, TypeScript, UI libraries and schema validators such as Yup, Zod, AJV and Joi.
contains: hooks: useForm, useController, useFormContext, useWatch, useFormState, useFieldArray
no dependencies and small package size
schema validation with Yup, Zod, AJV, Superstruct, Joi
works with React Native and TypeScript
